hnlnl_2d3d.description: HNLNL: 20 elective head-and-neck structures; Level_V_L/R combine Va/Vb/Vc. Ia, VIa, VIb and VIIa are unsided.
hnlnl_2d3d.limitations: No separate Va/Vb/Vc, IX or Xa/Xb outputs. Published manual coverage selection and removal of table/immobilisation material are not reproduced by the full-series runner.
hnlnl_2d3d.evidence_note: Published mean per-level Dice 0.76; intraobserver 0.77 (p=0.307), volume-weighted Dice 0.78. The mirror-TTA change requires technical rechecking; earlier serialization Dice 1.0 is not contour accuracy.

clnet_235.weights_license: Apache-2.0 archive metadata; nodal weights absent
clnet_235.description: CL-Net configuration has 33 nodal entries: 18 neck and 15 chest. The released archive contains seven decoders with no nodal labels; Task1007/1008 are absent.
clnet_235.limitations: Chest stations 8 and 9 are unsided; no station 11 entry. Configuration labels are not available predictions.
clnet_235.evidence_note: No nodal accuracy can be assigned to missing decoders.

choi_tmli.description: Choi TMLI: 18 broad lymphatic regions. Numeric-to-anatomical mapping and storage/preprocessing remain unresolved.
choi_tmli.limitations: Disabled. A label-sheet approval alone cannot resolve preprocessing. The default axis variant is unconfirmed.
choi_tmli.evidence_note: Paper: median Dice 0.79; precision 0.83; recall 0.76; HD95 2.63 pixels (IQR 2.00–4.58), not millimetres. Composite TMLI ontology, not a pelvic cancer-specific atlas.

lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.weights_license: Separate checkpoint licence not supplied; dataset CC BY 4.0 is distinct
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.description: LNCTVSeg: six NPC-specific unions, bilateral II–III–Va, IV–Vb and Ib. These cannot be separated into generic nodal levels.
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.limitations: Eight checkpoint channels: background, IDs 1–6 and undocumented ID 7. nnU-Net exports 1–6 unchanged, omits 7 and logs its volume; other architectures remain inference-contract blocked.
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.evidence_note: The nnU-Net technical acceptance metadata match the pinned manifest; its pending descriptive status is stale. This does not establish independent accuracy. The manifest is hash-guarded.

lnctvseg_swinunetr.weights_license: Separate checkpoint licence not supplied; dataset CC BY 4.0 is distinct
lnctvseg_swinunetr.description: LNCTVSeg SwinUNETR: intended six NPC nodal unions, bilateral II–III–Va, IV–Vb and Ib; no accepted runnable export.
lnctvseg_swinunetr.limitations: Release-specific ROI size, spacing, orientation and intensity transforms are missing. Checkpoint class 7 is undocumented. The nnU-Net omission policy is not an accepted inference contract for this architecture.
lnctvseg_swinunetr.evidence_note: Published internal mean Dice 83.49%; no accuracy is assigned to an unimplemented local export.

lnctvseg_3duxnet.weights_license: Separate checkpoint licence not supplied; dataset CC BY 4.0 is distinct

lnctvseg_3duxnet.evidence_note: Published internal mean Dice 83.43%; no accuracy is assigned to an unimplemented local export.

lnsegfm_nnunet.evidence_note: Published internal Dice 81.72%; 36,106 annotated visible nodes on 3,346 RADCURE CT scans. Historical execution/export checks are not independent accuracy.

compai_lnq.description: CompAI Model 7: mediastinal node candidates on CT. No IASLC station regions or malignancy classification.
compai_lnq.limitations: LNQ targets clinically relevant enlarged nodes; this is not a complete inventory of normal-sized nodes.
compai_lnq.evidence_note: Published Model 7 LNQ test Dice 0.663 and ASSD 3.97 mm; original challenge 0.628/5.8 mm is a different configuration.

dbdmp_lnq.description: DBDMP: mediastinal node candidates on CT; no elective station regions.
dbdmp_lnq.limitations: Portal repairs crop geometry and uses a documented compatible trainer; accuracy reproduction is unresolved.
dbdmp_lnq.evidence_note: Published validation DSC 54.10%/ASSD 8.72 mm; test 55.44%/9.35 mm; best test configuration 57.36%/9.85 mm. These are distinct configurations.

raidionics_mediastinal_lymphnodes.description: Raidionics/Bouget: binary mediastinal node candidates on contrast CT.
raidionics_mediastinal_lymphnodes.limitations: Training station assignments do not turn the binary output into station-region contours.
raidionics_mediastinal_lymphnodes.evidence_note: Exact ONNX-release accuracy was not verified.

lnq_atlas.description: LNQ atlas model: binary mediastinal node candidates with probabilistic-atlas context. No station-region outputs.
lnq_atlas.limitations: Disabled: complete archive/fold verification, runtime and technical checks remain pending. The upstream archive was reachable on 2026-10-18 (HTTP 200), so the earlier access failure no longer applies.
lnq_atlas.evidence_note: Published ensemble Dice 0.6033 and detection of 57% of reference nodes versus 27% with CT-only training.

wcode_pia.description: WCODE-PIA: intended mediastinal node candidates; Baidu-hosted release access is the recorded blocker.
wcode_pia.limitations: The checkpoint must be obtained, licensed and pinned before integration.
wcode_pia.evidence_note: Current source reports DSC 57.97±15.90%, ASSD 10.88±11.40 mm and instance F1 31.66±14.83%; no reproduced local checkpoint pairing.

uwlair_hntsmrg_pre_t2.description: UWLAIR pre-RT: GTVp and GTVn from one pre-treatment T2 head-and-neck MRI; ten-model ensemble.
uwlair_hntsmrg_pre_t2.limitations: The mid-treatment model requires a registered prior image/mask and is a different input contract.
uwlair_hntsmrg_pre_t2.evidence_note: Upstream pre-RT GTVp/GTVn DSC 0.745/0.844. Historical geometry/export checks are not independent patient-level nodal Dice.

stunet_hntsmrg_pre.description: STU-Net: intended pre-RT T2 MRI GTVp/GTVn.
stunet_hntsmrg_pre.limitations: Disabled: preprocessing plans/properties, fold/export metadata and wrapper are absent. Raw checkpoints cannot establish this contract.
stunet_hntsmrg_pre.evidence_note: No accuracy transferred to the unimplemented runner.

segrap2023_gtv.evidence_note: Historical use of one CT duplicated into both channels establishes execution only.

voxtell_v1_1_text_prompted.description: VoxTell: one text target per job. Points and boxes are ignored. Cached terms do not prove elective-region accuracy.

voxtell_v1_1_text_prompted.evidence_note: No nodal-region accuracy established by the historical local object/geometry checks.

nninteractive_v1_prompted.description: nnInteractive: place a positive point inside one node; use negatives to exclude adjacent vessels. One structure per prompt; repeat for other nodes.
nninteractive_v1_prompted.limitations: One binary Prompted_Target ROI. No verified elective nodal atlas contract.
nninteractive_v1_prompted.evidence_note: No nodal-region accuracy established by the historical local object/geometry checks.

segvol_prompted_ct.description: SegVol: use points or a tight 3D box around one node. Do not combine points and a box. No verified nodal text vocabulary.
segvol_prompted_ct.limitations: One binary Prompted_Target ROI. No verified elective nodal atlas contract.
segvol_prompted_ct.evidence_note: Historical spleen Dice: text 0.9801, point 0.9756, box 0.9791; no nodal accuracy was measured.
